name: Virginia Textile Service, Inc.
old_description: Since 1934, Your Linen Service has provided local linen, mat, and uniform rental services designed to help your employees thrive—so your business succeeds. From seamless laundry solutions to tailored programs, we support the hospitality, healthcare, and restaurant industries.
about:
Virginia Textile Service, Inc., operating as Your Linen Service, has been based in Petersburg, Virginia since its founding in 1934. The company remains family-owned and operated, now celebrating over 90 years of continuous service.

The business provides linen, uniform, mat, and mop rental programs along with laundry and hygiene services to customers across Virginia and neighboring states. Rather than relying on large centralized plants, Your Linen Service operates a network of local service centers that handle textile cleaning, maintenance, and delivery. The service includes restroom hygiene supplies such as hand sanitizers, soap dispensers, and paper products. The company emphasizes resource conservation and sustainable practices in its operations.

Customers span hospitality, healthcare, and food-service sectors. Hotels, inns, country clubs, spas, restaurants, hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, and barber shops all use the rental programs. Testimonials cite a healthcare provider in North Carolina, an auto repair shop in West Virginia, restaurants in Virginia and Maryland, and a bistro in the Washington, D.C. area as long-term clients.

The company says its differentiation lies in its family-owned structure, local service-center model, and environmental commitment. Management describes the approach as “Service means that the Customer has what they need – when they need it,” and highlights that staying smaller and local allows faster response than industry-wide centralized facilities.
